hero_framing:

Rep 68 — the flagged account is growing, not declining. $36K billed in the current period with no prior baseline to compare against. No recovery needed here; the call is forward-looking. It's been 48 days since the last order — confirm what's in the queue and make sure the momentum is real, not one-time.
play_framing: $25K flagged across the rep base in discretionary-price dispersion — 0.34% of $7.3M invoiced. The headline dollar is small. The spread within the flagged group is not: leak rates run 5.6% to 7.1%. The rep at 7.1% is above the threshold where this becomes a discount-authority question, not just a pricing reminder. That is the one conversation worth having before it compounds.

outreach_framing: Four of the seven calls are real declines — accounts where revenue materially fell half-over-half, not a timing skip. The other three are active or new accounts where the call is forward-looking: confirm momentum, find the next order. Run the declines first. The conversations are different and conflating them costs credibility on both sides.
